user.title: Add an openframe frame
user.description: Enter the address of the frame. Its web UI shows it on the start screen, for example 192.168.100.215 and port 8080.

data_description.host: IP address or host name of the frame.
data_description.port: Port of the frame's web UI, 8080 unless changed.

pair.title: Pair with {name}
pair.description: The frame {name} now shows a six-digit pairing code. Type it here.

reauth_confirm.title: Pair {name} again
reauth_confirm.description: The frame {name} no longer accepts Home Assistant's pairing. When you continue, the frame shows a new pairing code.

reconfigure.title: New address of the frame
reconfigure.description: Enter the frame's new address. The pairing is kept.

data_description.host: IP address or host name of the frame.
data_description.port: Port of the frame's web UI, 8080 unless changed.

error.cannot_connect: Cannot connect to the frame. Check the address and that the frame is switched on.
error.not_openframe: No openframe frame answers at this address.
error.invalid_code: Wrong code. Type the six digits the frame shows.
error.expired_code: The code has expired. The frame now shows a new code.
error.locked: Pairing is locked after too many wrong codes. Wait a minute and try again.
error.wrong_frame: Another frame answers at this address.

abort.already_configured: This frame is already set up.
abort.cannot_connect: The frame stopped answering during the pairing. Try again.
abort.outdated_frame: The frame's openframe app is too old. Update it to openframe {version} or later and add the frame again.
abort.wrong_frame: Another frame answers at the stored address. Use Reconfigure to enter the frame's new address.
abort.unexpected_answer: The frame answered the pairing check unexpectedly: {message}

unauthorized.message: The frame no longer accepts Home Assistant's pairing. Pair the frame again.

display_unavailable.message: The frame cannot switch its display: openframe is not a device administrator.

safe_mode.message: The frame is in safe mode.

not_in_safe_mode.message: The frame is not in safe mode.

update_not_ready.message: No update is downloaded and ready to install.

install_not_allowed.message: Android does not allow openframe to install apps on the frame.

install_in_progress.message: The installation dialog is already open on the frame.

install_cooldown.message: An installation was just cancelled. Try again in a few minutes.

source_no_folder.message: Choose a folder for this source in the frame's web UI first.

outdated_frame.title: {name} needs a newer openframe
outdated_frame.description: {name} no longer offers an endpoint this integration needs, for example because an older openframe was installed on it. Update the frame to openframe {version} or later; Home Assistant connects again by itself.
